Daily Devotional

July 19

3 But the Lord is faithful, who shall stablish you, and keep you from evil. (2 Thessalonians 3:3 KJV)

Paul is saying that these are the reasons that he could stay full of joy during all the persecutions he endured, was that God was faithful to establish (to confirm) him as well as keep him from evil. If you keep God as your focus in life, He will confirm you and help keep you from evil. It sure does pay to follow God’s leading (Proverbs 3:5).

God told us to pray that we be kept from evil (Matthew 6:13), and Jesus prayed this for His followers on the night before His crucifixion (John 17:15). God wants to keep His followers from evil, but we have to accept His leading by faith, or it will not happen. This doesn’t mean that we will never run into evil, but that the Lord will see us through any adversity that we run into. The ways of the Lord are so awesome, and we need to praise Him every day, in every way (Psalms 100:4). We must listen to Jesus and obey Him to assure our eternal salvation (Hebrews 5:9). Thank you Father for all your blessings.
